footnotes.228269: - i.e., the horses bearing riders as they race to attack the enemy.

2.text: And the producers of sparks [when] striking<sup foot_note="228270">1</sup>

footnotes.228270: - Their hoofs while galloping over rocky terrain.

3.text: And the chargers at dawn,<sup foot_note="228271">1</sup>

5.text: Arriving thereby in the center<sup foot_note="228272">1</sup> collectively,

footnotes.228272: - i.e., penetrating into the enemy ranks during a surprise attack.

6.text: Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.

7.text: And indeed, he is to that a witness.<sup foot_note="228273">1</sup>

footnotes.228273: - Through his speech and his actions.

8.text: And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.

9.text: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered

10.text: And that within the breasts is obtained,<sup foot_note="228274">1</sup>

footnotes.228274: - i.e., when all secrets are made known.

11.text: Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Aware.<sup foot_note="228275">1</sup>

footnotes.228275: - Fully acquainted and familiar with everything about each one of them.
